text: APPROVE: The extraction keeps the original order (template sites, then style-object sites, then animate sites) and the same guards and conditions, and moving the nested loops into three helpers leaves `InScript` with only two top-level `if`s. I could only review the diff, not the repo, so the parameter types (`IReadOnlySet<string>` for `guards`, `IReadOnlyDictionary<string, bool>` for `keyframes`) are unchecked against the helper signatures they feed into.
